groups.name: Core (print, pt)
groups.note: Values are points on an 11x17 poster; px values in this file equal pt.

styles.name: h1-print
styles.sample: BECAUSE GOOD MUSIC SOUNDS BETTER TOGETHER.
styles.usage: H1: Panchi Mono, ALL CAPS, 15pt type / 18pt leading (~120%), 6pt paragraph space. Values are points on an 11x17 poster; px here equals pt.
styles.label: H1

styles.name: p1-print
styles.sample: We're creating a listening space on Salt Spring Island.
styles.usage: P1: Panchi Mono, sentence case, 10pt type / 12pt leading (~120%), 6pt paragraph space. Lineups, addresses, URLs.
styles.label: P1

styles.name: social-statement
styles.sample: Because good music sounds better together.
styles.usage: Manifesto and About carousel copy, sentence case. Measured: cap height ~70px, line pitch 120px on a 1728px-wide post.

styles.name: social-header
styles.usage: Two-column header on artist profile and radio posts. ALL CAPS except am/pm. Measured approx. (cap ~44px, pitch 76px).

styles.name: social-small
styles.usage: Footnotes under time tables (Free entry, $15 in advance). Estimated from About posts; confirm against source files.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen headline, ALL CAPS. H1 ratio (1.2) carried to screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A place where music matters, where we listen and connect.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Running heads and labels, ALL CAPS, as in the guide's page headers.

tokens.name: social-margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin on 1728px-wide posts (measured 38–40px on manifesto, about and profile posts). Scale by width for other canvases (48px at 2160).

tokens.name: social-column-2
tokens.usage: x-position of the second text column on 1728px profile and radio headers (date, time, venue).

tokens.name: social-column-body
tokens.usage: x-position of the body column on About posts (label column at the margin, body at ~1/3 width).

tokens.name: print-paragraph
tokens.usage: Paragraph space after H1 and P1 in print (6pt).

tokens.name: mark-width-social
tokens.usage: Width of the AFW mark on profile and radio posts, as a share of canvas width, flush to the bottom-right corner.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Grounds, bands, panels and photos are square-cornered; roundness lives only inside the letterforms.

meta.source: Brand/AFW_001_Brand-Guideline_1.0.pdf (Memory Studio, May 2025) + measured from Brand/Applications files
